targets.title: Subtyping attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder using temperament dimensions: toward biologically based nosologic criteria.
targets.evidence_quote: First, we report an independent replication of Karalunas et al. (2014) in a new sample using the same statistical grouping approach (community detection).
targets.outcome_quote: In an era when reproducibility is increasingly seen as vital to the field, we focused first on attempting to reproduce the results reported by Karalunas et al. (2014) . The 3-group profile replicated well in a new sample.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly judge the replicated three-profile structure as successful; later longitudinal analyses extend the initial finding.

reasoning: Independent new sample explicitly re-tests the published temperament profiles. Pooled longitudinal analyses are extensions, not additional original targets.
